title: Controller Work Identity
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, let a finite CSP template and an input on finitely many variables be given. The work of the input’s local controller equals the total conditional-expectation work, namely the sum, over all variables, of the work of the corresponding local conditional step.
hypotheses_covered: Input with finite variable set and CSP instance
